policy: Every FE out/f probe field must be consumed by OS/BR/RPA/device scoring or listed here with why-not-use. Error/skip markers are consumed as probe_gap_* conf demotes when present; pure structural bookkeeping without decision value is intentional_unused.

intentional_unused._audio_p: internal collector scratch pointer; not a product signal
intentional_unused.b10_meta: lab-only debug bag; stripped/ignored for product axes
intentional_unused.n_own: census internal counter; leaf_est/object_census carries product signal
intentional_unused.sample_buffers: webgl context creation option echo; not decision material
intentional_unused.dither_enabled: webgl state echo without claim-obs pairing yet
intentional_unused.aliased_line_width_range: raw GL range array; gl_max_* + precision matrix used instead
intentional_unused.aliased_point_size_range: raw GL range array; covered by caps/precision family
intentional_unused.os_instance_source: debug provenance of os_instance_hash; hash itself is used
intentional_unused.residual_probe_engine: engine tag for residual path; engine_family already scored
intentional_unused.cross_context_algo: algo id string; cross_residual_* values are scored
intentional_unused.data_ok: batch completeness flag for FE queue; not an identity signal
intentional_unused.name: generic name scratch
intentional_unused.webdriver_get: intermediate getter probe; webdriver bool scored
intentional_unused.nightmare: legacy bot global name check intermediate
intentional_unused.cpu_ms: timing scratch; wall metrics scored elsewhere
intentional_unused.alt_changed: pohw intermediate already scored as pohw_alt_changed when present
